questions

The short answers

What is Voris?

Voris is a privacy-first analytics platform built for the AI-influenced web. It does two jobs in one place: classic web analytics without cookies or personal data, and AI visibility, meaning what ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Grok say about your brand. The part nobody else does: it connects the two, so a citation in an AI answer can be traced to the visit it produced and the conversion that followed.

Do I need a cookie banner for Voris?

No. Voris does not use cookies, localStorage, or any other browser storage, and it does not store personal data. There is nothing to ask consent for. We are commissioning a written legal opinion from a leading EU privacy firm on exactly this question and will publish it in full.

Do I need to replace my current analytics?

No. Voris runs happily alongside whatever you use today. Most customers start by running it in parallel, comparing for a few weeks, and then deciding. The install takes about a minute, so the experiment is cheap.

Does Voris slow down my site?

The script is built to stay tiny, loads asynchronously, and never blocks rendering. Your visitors will not notice it. Your Core Web Vitals will not either.

Can Voris identify my individual visitors?

No. By design there is no visitor profile to look at. We count what happened, not who did it.

How long does setup take?

About a minute. Create a site, copy one script tag or install the WordPress plugin or Shopify app, and your first data appears on the dashboard within seconds of the first visit.

See what AI says, sends, and earns you

问题

简短的答案

What is Voris?

Voris 是一个隐私优先的分析平台，专为受人工智能影响的网络而构建。 它在一个地方完成两项工作：没有 cookie 或个人数据的经典网络分析，以及 AI 可见性，这意味着 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和 Grok 对您的品牌的评价。 其他人做不到的部分：它将两者联系起来，因此人工智能答案中的引用可以追溯到它产生的访问以及随后的转换。

Do I need a cookie banner for Voris?

不会。Voris 不使用 cookie、localStorage 或任何其他浏览器存储，也不存储个人数据。 没有什么需要征求同意的。 我们正在委托一家领先的欧盟隐私公司就这个问题撰写书面法律意见，并将完整发布。

Do I need to replace my current analytics?

不会。Voris 可以与您今天使用的任何设备一起愉快地运行。 大多数客户首先并行运行，比较几周，然后做出决定。 安装大约需要一分钟，因此实验成本很低。

Does Voris slow down my site?

该脚本被构建为保持小型、异步加载并且从不阻止渲染。 您的访客不会注意到它。 您的 Core Web Vitals 也不会。

Can Voris identify my individual visitors?

不会。按照设计，没有访客资料可供查看。 我们计算的是发生了什么，而不是是谁干的。

How long does setup take?

大约一分钟。 创建网站、复制一个脚本标签或安装 WordPress 插件或 Shopify 应用程序，您的第一个数据将在第一次访问后几秒钟内显示在仪表板上。
